title: Manifest common definitions
description: Shared sub-schemas reused across the run / condition / pass / analysis manifests. Referenced via relative $ref (e.g. "common-defs.schema.json#/$defs/provenance"). Kept in one file so the provenance, scope, and confidence-interval shapes cannot drift between manifests.
$comment: This file defines no top-level instance; it is a $defs library only.

provenance.description: Generator-written audit trail for every machine-extracted row. Per the project anti-confabulation rule, every extracted value must trace to a source file; missing values are null, never guessed.

source_files.description: Repository-relative paths of every file the row's values were extracted from.

last_extracted_at.description: When the generator last (re-)extracted this row.

extractor_version.description: Semantic version of the generator script that wrote the row (tracks the script, NOT the manifest format — the manifest format is the top-level schema_version).

e81_correction.description: Correction stamp where erratum E81 re-derived a row's tile MCC. Row-specific by design: a generic corrections array would generalise better, but this is the key E81 wrote into the committed manifest.

scope.description: An evaluation tile pool. Vocabulary is the canonical tile-pool taxonomy in results/evaluation-scopes.md. On a run this is the nominal/design-intent scope; on a condition (scope_override) it is the as-evaluated truth when it diverges.

test_set_id.description: Identifier of the test tile pool (e.g. era-2-487, era-3-327, 55-map-8541).

bounds_path.description: Repository-relative path of the .geojson defining the pool.

calibration_set_id.description: Identifier of the calibration tile pool, where one applies.

confidenceInterval.description: A bootstrap confidence interval. Project standard: BCa via scipy.stats.bootstrap, tile-level resampling, seed 42, 1000 or 10000 iterations.
